SRC-138:R001.text: Do not substitute post-generation style checking for session admission.

SRC-138:R003.text: There must be one canonical runtime owner for session protocol admission.

SRC-138:R004.text: Do not place the admission truth separately in:

SRC-138:R006.text: Admission must prove current generations/fingerprints for at least:

SRC-138:R008.text: Do not merely remove the requirement or pretend invocation succeeded.

SRC-138:R009.text: A. the skill is admission-critical and must be installed/resolved; B. the skill identity/path changed and canonical resolution is stale; C. the skill is decorative and should never have been admission-critical.

SRC-138:R010.text: admission must not silently become ADMITTED.

SRC-138:R011.text: Do NOT let the model print:

SRC-138:R012.text: The model whose admission failed must not author that diagnostic.

SRC-138:R013.text: The old admission token must fail after invalidation.

SRC-138:R014.text: Do not collapse these into one heuristic classifier.

SRC-138:R015.text: A green later layer must never compensate for a failed earlier layer.

SRC-138:R016.text: Codex, OpenCode, ZAICODE, generic, and other hosts must be classified from their actual mechanics.

SRC-138:R017.text: CHAT_STYLE MUST NOT BECOME A SECOND PROTOCOL

SRC-138:R019.text: The checker may compile them into a runtime form, but must preserve one owner.

SRC-138:R020.text: Do not use locale-dependent default decoding.

SRC-138:R021.text: The fix must not make Windows cp1251 legacy input silently corrupt elsewhere.

SRC-138:R022.text: The repaired implementation must reject the same carriers through the same oracle.

SRC-138:R023.text: Do not accept tests that only verify newly written code in isolation.

SRC-138:R024.text: Admission acceptance must use admission-specific RED/GREEN controls and host interception evidence.

SRC-138:R025.text: Do not let roadmap creation interrupt the active hard-admission repair.

SRC-138:R027.text: do not turn the roadmap into execution authority

SRC-138:R028.text: do not automatically enqueue the entire future roadmap as Work.

SRC-138:R029.text: Do not leave temporary repair machinery in production surfaces accidentally.

SRC-138:R030.text: Do not delete unknown foreign WIP.

SRC-138:R031.text: Do not close from BUILD or from isolated green tests.

SRC-138:R032.text: Healthy user experience must be boring:

SRC-138:R033.text: The user must not need to read another explanation of why the model forgot the protocol.
